name: Retool
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Retool, build one internal CRUD tool over a trusted database with role-aware actions. The hard boundary is connectors, component library, permissions, workflows, and hosted runtime, plus connectors, runtime reliability, and governance.
